_comment: Per-app content. Copy, fill in, and point APPSTORE_CONFIG at it. Credentials come from env (ASC_KEY_ID/ISSUER/P8) and the numeric ASC_APP_ID from env. Values may be in any language — this is your store content.

metadata.name: App Name
metadata.subtitle: Subtitle, max 30 chars
metadata.description: Full description. NO emoji (ASC rejects them). Use plain uppercase section headers.
metadata.whatsNew: Release notes — ONLY for updates; leave empty on the first submission

review.notes: The app is fully usable without an account. ...

screenshots._note: 1290x2796 PNGs, no alpha. APP_IPHONE_67 is the largest iPhone slot (covers 6.7/6.9) — there is no APP_IPHONE_69. Filename order = display order. This dir must contain ONLY store screenshots.

credentials._note: Where `credentials` writes the .p12 / .mobileprovision / credentials.json. Gitignore this dir.

subscription._note: Omit this whole block if the app has no subscription.
